The specifications for this requirement will only be available upon solicitation issuance. Requirement: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineer (USACE), Philadelphia District (NAP), anticipates a requirement of a rental bucket boat for the C&D Canal. Description: The C&D Canal project office will require the long-term rental for a bucket boat for the planned replacement of the canal bank lights. The canal uses lights that are fixed atop dolphins to mark the north and south limits of the navigation channel. These dolphins are located in the water along the canal from Reedy Point to Town Point and are in depths of water that vary from 10’ to less than 1’. The dolphins cannot be reached from land and will require a specialized vessel to reach the lights at the top of the dolphins – approximately 25’ above the water surface. The vessel provided will need to be able to operate in shallow water and be able to provide a stable working platform at least 25’ above the water surface. There are approximately 80 dolphin lights that need to be replaced, it is assumed that the rental period for vessel will be 2 months. A captain and all personnel associated with the operation of the vessel shall also be provided with the vessel rental. C&D personnel will supply all labor and materials necessary for the replacement of lights. The vessel should have sufficient capacity to accommodate 3 USACE personnel in addition to those provided to operate the vessel. The estimated period of performance will be 30 calendar days. The anticipated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code is 532411, Commercial, Air, and Water Transportation Equipement Rental and Leasing with an SBA Size standard of $45.5M. Survey: The Government is issuing this notice to determine a competitive basis. This is not a solicitation and the items listed herein are subject to change or eliminated from the requirement. This survey is for market research purposes only. Only prospective contractors capable of performing this type of work should respond to this Request for Information.
